author: mark
text:
Add streaming Anthropic client (raw SSE)

Child #3 of the bl-d15d streaming epic: Anthropic-native SSE wire
layer inside lernie-provider-anthropic. Adds Client::send_streaming,
Event enum (with Unknown catchall), EventStream iterator, accumulate
helper, and Error::Sse. Adapter contract unchanged; §4.4 normalized
events ship with bl-de80. 21 new tests, 100% coverage stable across
3 make check runs.
